# The Bureau of Provisions

> A stainless steel bottle design with a folding steel straw, wide drinking spout and optional mist. The first release is in development. Current CAD dimensions and nominal capacity are available; final production details and colours remain in development.

## Product

- [The bottle](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#ways): Six interactive feature descriptions: mist, straw, spout, one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks, double-wall stainless steel and dishwasher-safe cleaning.
- [Anatomy and specifications](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#specifications): An illustrative half-cutaway, material specifications and current Original/Mist CAD dimensions: 207.7 mm closed overall height, 185.4 mm body height and 65 mm body diameter. The 500 mL capacity is nominal design capacity, not a measured liquid volume.
- [Two-tone colour studies](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#colourways): Nineteen brighter palettes and striped strap studies for ages 6–10. Includes princess, football, space and superhero palette editions. Colours change only; the original bottle geometry and one continuous detachable carry strap with clip-on snap hooks are preserved.
- [Register to pre-order](https://bureauofprovisions.com/#colourways): Choose an edition and register interest through Tally. Pre-order price is £39 per bottle; ships internationally. Registration takes no payment; ordering details will follow.
